chapters.title: Edgepad
lines: Laptop's plugged into the TV. You're on the couch. Your phone's already in your hand.
That's your remote now. Meet Edgepad.
Pair once over Bluetooth, tap your laptop, and you're in.
The middle is a trackpad. Scroll, pinch, and swipe between desktops.
Every corner is a dial. Slide for volume, brightness, zoom, or to scrub a video.
Flip one switch, and four dials can become eight.
Whatever's playing lives right on the pad.
Up to fifteen macros, one tap away, in a deck you arrange.
A keyboard, a gamepad, a pen for the laptop's screen, and capture. All in Controls.
Windows, Mac or Linux. No account. No server. No internet.
Edgepad. Free and open source, on GitHub.
